contentText: Ever since 1965 when the French first got to cast a ballot by universal suffrage for their president, they've valued campaign rules that guarantee ‘equal time’ for candidates. But what does equal time mean when you're closing in on 2027? Last week a bombshell announcement ahead of next Spring’s presidential elections: major online content creators will have to respect the same balanced air time rules as traditional TV and radio broadcasters during the campaign period. Here at France 24, we’re already testing the stopwatches and combing ove the guest list spreadsheets. Should podcasters, YouTubers and influencers be subjected to the same rules as us?
